text:
tori_sales: OrchidPay wants a near drop-in for CompetitorX. POC kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. They asked for compatibility notes, committed pricing examples, and the completed security questionnaire before the demo.
ben_engineer: They use a header-based streaming pattern (X-Stream-Token + chunked SSE). We don't accept that header verbatim today but can translate in an adapter/proxy. Low effort for POC. @priya_se any behavioral deltas to call out? :thinking: 
priya_se: Prompt-parity gotchas: competitor pads system messages and uses sampling defaults that bias generations. Plan: map system prompt -> system, default temperature=0.2 for their workloads, and include a mapping doc + test harness.
josh_infra: They need static egress IPs for staging/CIDR allowlist. We can assign them the dedicated staging pool but legal needs to confirm outbound peer rules. CC @mike_security.
mike_security: Uploaded redacted security bundle and SOC2 link to drive. I'll take first pass on their 30-question vendor questionnaire but need their specific KMS/HSM constraints (FIPS?).
priya_se: Response differences: they run prefix trimming and remove repeated salutations. Recommend a post-processing shim in the POC to mirror that behavior to avoid perceived drift.
ben_engineer: Adapter example curl to share with their engs (emulates CompetitorX -> our POC shim): curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' -H 'X-Stream-Token: abc123' -d '{"model":"redwood-compat-v1","prompt":"<user_prompt>","max_tokens":512}' https://staging.redwood.example.com/compat/stream
tori_sales: Good. Include in kickoff deck. Pricing ask: committed discount examples. @finance_bot paste quick math for 1M tokens/mo vs on-demand.
finance_bot: On-demand baseline: $0.06 / 1k input+output tokens. Commit 1M/mo -> 20% discount -> $0.048 / 1k. Commit 3M/mo -> 35% discount -> $0.039 / 1k. Note Dedicated contract option (platform fee + SLA).
tori_sales: I'll show committed tiers and a one-time adapter services line.
mike_security: Blocker: OrchidPay requires FIPS-validated KMS for production keys. We can do POC with customer-managed keys in staging KMS but full FIPS needs private deployment conversation.
ben_engineer: Timeline: translation shim + post-process in staging within ~48 hours. We'll run a 20-prompt smoke suite for parity.
priya_se: I'll draft mapping doc and the 20-prompt smoke tests tonight and link them here.
tori_sales: Thanks — drop links here as you add them. I'll loop in OrchidPay CISO and their eng lead after IPs and security Q answers are confirmed. :+1:
